description: The Yangtze dataset aggregates HydroATLAS and MODIS variables for environmental-flow classification. Principal components and k-means group subbasins using climatic, ecological and hydrogeomorphic characteristics. This resource is provided by Britne Clifton; Anna Rallings; Joshua Viers. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Temporal aggregation and variable selection remove detail available in the parent datasets. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
